title: Heidi Clone PageSpec
description: Machine contract for a generated PageSpec instance. `basedOnTemplate` is a closed enum of the 26 real page shapes in templates/templates.json; `nodes[].section` is a closed enum of the 80 real section contracts in sections/. Each node's `content` is validated against that exact section's own independent content schema via an if/then branch keyed on `section` (draft-07 additionalProperties:false trap avoided: every branch's content schema is fully independent, not a shared-base patch). Structural cross-referencing of a PageSpec's nodes[] against its declared template's real node list happens in schema/semantic_validate.py, not here -- JSON Schema alone cannot express that.
